scope: Screening is a biased 139-case sample. Full selection reuses verified frozen objects. Timing covers named inputs only.

compile_time.method: Sequential process launches after compiler/runtime probes finish. One warmup plus seven measured rounds; arm order rotates by input and round. Selection includes Python startup, identity hashing, multiple complete frontend/backend compilations, section queries and report output. Shared host; no claim about integrated LLVM overhead.
